# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read and follow `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root. It is the source of truth for this
project's constraints and working agreement. In short:

- JSS 22.12.3 in disconnected mode. Do not upgrade JSS, Node, or React, do not add
  GraphQL, and do not migrate to the Sitecore Content SDK.
- Work on one GitHub issue at a time and stay inside its scope.
- Explain Sitecore, Docker, and CI concepts when introducing them.
- User writes code by hand unless explicitly instructed otherwise. If requested, provide code snippets or guidance only.
- Never commit secrets.
